ABOUT ERAGON

Eragon is an Applied AI lab building an AI platform that powers self-improving agents for business enterprise. We’re working on memory, runtime, integrations, and product experience that make agents useful, reliable, and governable in real-world settings.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, you’ll shape Eragon’s product direction and turn customer needs, technical capabilities, and research insights into products people can rely on. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and customer-facing teammates to discover problems, make sharp product decisions, and ship improvements across the agent experience. We’re looking for an AI-native product thinker with prior experience building AI products.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead product discovery with customers and internal teams to identify high-value problems and workflows.

 - Define product direction, requirements, and priorities, balancing user value, technical feasibility, and business impact.

 - Partner with engineering and design to prototype, build, launch, and improve AI-powered product experiences.

 - Use customer feedback, product data, and evaluation results to assess quality and guide iteration.

 - Communicate product decisions clearly and keep teams aligned from early exploration through delivery.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience as a product manager or product builder on AI products, with a strong understanding of how AI changes product design and user workflows.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into focused, testable plans.

 - Comfort working closely with engineers and designers on technical products and making tradeoffs.

 - A user-centered, iterative approach to discovery, prototyping, and measuring outcomes.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, ownership, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.
